purpose: Bind the existing economic sensing, CUBE, silo, Swarm, Elohim, Gauntlet, authority, commerce, Truth Oracle, BECK and telemetry substrate into one evidence-gated Evergreen reproduction loop without creating a new ledger, queue, orchestrator, or truth system.

777.cell: ECONOMIC_EVENT + BUYER + PROBLEM + OFFER + SURFACE + MESSAGE + CTA + FULFILLMENT + EVIDENCE

roles.cube: Compile economically interesting substrate into bounded experimental cells and silos. Never certify demand or truth.
roles.supabase: Canonical silo home for identity, state, lineage, evidence and telemetry.
roles.swarm: Generate bounded 5-10 variants inside the existing sandbox. Never create authority.
roles.elohim: Create, refine and repair candidates and propose Gauntlet scorecards. Never certify truth.
roles.gauntlet: Adversarially judge every Elohim output and fail closed on policy, evidence, authority or blast-radius violations.
roles.authority_gate: Permit external effects only when existing authority and the required human gate are present.
roles.truth_oracle: Public economic truth boundary. Independent external evidence outranks internal telemetry.
roles.beck: Immutable internal ledger of system activity, attribution and economic events. BECK does not create external truth.
roles.telemetry: Allocate compute and attention from observed signals. Telemetry does not promote a mechanism to verified truth.
roles.evergreen: Replicate only an independently verified mechanism, preserving lineage and requiring fresh authorization for each external surface.
roles.supervisor: Allocate available LM Studio/GPU capacity between CUBE and Swarm. Compute allocation never creates authority or truth.
roles.lm_studio: Local reasoning and BECK worker capacity; cloud remains authoritative and may provide fallback acceleration.

existing_substrate.commerce: Existing approved offers, Stripe payment rail and fulfillment routes
existing_substrate.truth: Existing Truth Oracle and economic observation contracts

next_runtime_transition: ECONOMIC_EVENT_INGESTION -> CUBE_SILO -> ONE_CELL -> SWARM_TRACE -> GAUNTLET -> AUTHORIZED_EXPOSURE -> REAL_EXTERNAL_RESULT -> TRUTH_ORACLE -> BECK -> EVERGREEN
